messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "unusual mood changes, thoughts about hurting yourself"
set: ["unusual mood changes, thoughts about hurting yourself", "having thoughts about hurting yourself", "report thoughts about hurting yourself to your doctor", "unusual thoughts or behavior", "thoughts about suicide", "tell your healthcare provider about new or worsening depression, mood changes, or thoughts of suicide or self-harm", "unusual changes in mood or behavior", "having thoughts about suicide", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "some people have thoughts about suicide", "mood", "report thoughts about suicide to your doctor", "some young people have thoughts about suicide", "mood changes", "tell doctor about sudden mood or behavior changes", "mood swings"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "having thoughts about hurting yourself",
    "thoughts about suicide",
    "having thoughts about suicide",
    "tell your healthcare provider about new or worsening depression, mood changes, or thoughts of suicide or self-harm",
    "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide",
    "some people have thoughts about suicide",
    "some young people have thoughts about suicide",
    "tell doctor about sudden mood or behavior changes"
  ],
  "alias": "thoughts about suicide"
}
